title: Values after hardwiring
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+m$ inputs, let $y$ assign Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs, and let $x$ assign Boolean values to the first $n$ inputs. The list of vertex values produced by the circuit obtained by hardwiring $y$ at $x$ equals the list produced by $C$ at the concatenated assignment $(x,y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs
$x$ assigns Boolean values to the first $n$ inputs
